## Validation and limitations

The strategy retrieved all five screened relevant development records: **relative recall 5/5 (100%)**. This is not independent validation or sensitivity; there were no user-supplied seeds, held-out records, or independent benchmark set. Endemic setting, uncomplicated status, severity, reference standard, and species-specific results remain screening criteria. The setting block was left out because it would have lost two known relevant records.
